samples.question: The image is divided by thin lines into four quadrants: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Each quadrant contains one dark filled round shape of the same size. Three of the four shapes are solid disks, filled completely with no opening on the inside. Exactly one shape is a hollow ring: its inside is empty, showing a clearly visible enclosed cavity (a hole of background) at its centre. Which quadrant contains the hollow ring instead of a solid disk? Answer with the quadrant name.
